Class GroveAnalogGas

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors.GroveAnalogGas
public final class GroveAnalogGas extends Object
Reads the analog SIG output of a Grove gas sensor connected to an analog Grove socket. The ADC value is useful for observing changes, but is not a gas concentration: interpreting it requires the particular sensor's warm-up and calibration procedure. This class allocates nothing.
